78678.subject: 🤖 AGI is here, here's what we know about it
78678.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Nvidia's CEO declared AGI on Sunday, and OpenAI's chief scientist picked the same day to ask the whole industry to slow down. The chips behind Astra are why your Xbox costs $150 more. Anthropic answered the biggest week in AI with a 400-year-old math problem, and GTA VI fans got tired of waiting for Rockstar.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Nvidia:** Who called AGI, and who at OpenAI asked for the brakes the same day?

* **Consumer Reports:** Why does your Xbox cost $150 more?

* **Anthropic:** What did Claude finish in 11 days that took humans 358 years?

* **GTA VI:** Who's building the game before Rockstar ships it?


----------







----------
## AGI is here, here's what we know

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c1f8f175-338e-4500-bc4f-7774b116c050/Sep_7_-_1.jpg?t=1788771063)
Caption: 

Nvidia's CEO [said it on Sunday](https://x.com/JensenHuang/status/2096700264569090384). AGI has arrived. Jensen Huang built the 100,000 chips Astra trained on, and he's adding 400,000 more.

You've scrolled past a hundred AGI posts. This one's different because OpenAI backed it with its own numbers the same day.

* OpenAI's AI now does the research that builds the next AI. Its researchers get 3.1 days of machine work per human day, and the median one burns $600 a day in tokens.

* Altman's target was an AI intern doing days of research alone by this September, then a full AI researcher by March 2028. 

* The intern arrived on schedule. That leaves 18 months to AI that improves itself.

* **Claude got left in the dust for the first time in a while.** Astra beats Fable 5.1 on 17 of 19 tests OpenAI scored both on.

The AI intern is worth talking about a little more. It’s not a human intern using AI. It’s a full-on AI intern, no humans involved. This means AI will keep upgrading and improving itself very soon, which is the literal definition of AGI.

Doesn’t need instructions. Can teach itself. Keeps improving no matter what.

Then the chief scientist spoke. 

Jakub Pachocki wrote that no one is prepared for what's coming, no lab has solved alignment well enough to keep going at full speed and he wants the whole industry to slow down. Altman reposted it and called it important.

The man running research at the fastest lab on Earth asked for the brakes.


----------







----------
### The Future of AI in Marketing. Your Shortcut to Smarter, Faster Marketing.
